# v2.33-dev Release Notes

## Performance: faster reports as your data grows

Behind-the-scenes performance work aimed at keeping the app fast as more training
records are entered and more people use it at the same time. **Nothing looks or
behaves differently** — the same pages, the same numbers — they just do less work
to produce them. (Every affected report was verified to return byte-identical
results before and after these changes.)

### What changed

- **New database indexes on the busiest tables.** Reports and partner-program
  compliance screens constantly filter completions by training, expiry date and
  completion date, and filter students by country and theatre. Those columns are
  now indexed, so PostgreSQL can jump straight to the matching rows instead of
  scanning more of the table as it fills up. The bigger your dataset, the more
  this helps.

- **Fewer database round-trips in reports.** Three reports — *Trained But Not
  Certified*, *Legacy Replacement Gap*, and the *partner-program compliance*
  dashboards — used to fire a burst of separate database queries per training (or
  per theatre). They now batch that work into a handful of queries and combine
  the results in memory, so they scale with your catalogue instead of
  multiplying with it.

- **"Achieved in Last 12 Months" filters in the database.** It now asks
  PostgreSQL for just the recent completions (backed by a new completion-date
  index) instead of loading all history and filtering afterwards.

- **Tunable database connection pool.** The app now opens up to 20 database
  connections by default (previously 10), so heavy reports run by several people
  at once are less likely to queue behind each other. You can change the ceiling
  with the new optional `DATABASE_POOL_MAX` setting if your server or database is
  sized differently.

### Notes

- **A database migration runs on update** — it only *adds indexes* (no data is
  changed or moved). On a large existing table, building the indexes may take a
  short moment during the update; this is a one-time cost.
- No functional changes: all report outputs, filters, exports and dashboards are
  identical to before — this release only changes how the data is fetched.
- No configuration is required. `DATABASE_POOL_MAX` is optional and defaults to a
  sensible value.

### Coming next

Further phases will add short-lived caching for expensive report/compliance
computations and shared caching for reference data — again with no visible change
to how the app works.
